# Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API — facts

> Source-anchored units about Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API: 10 across 3 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

## How it works

- [statement] Alert configurations combine trigger conditions and notification methods. Pulumi also exposes a project AlertConfiguration resource, with projectId, eventType, enabled and notifications inputs. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/command/atlas-api-alertConfigurations-createAlertConfig.md · keywords: Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API · also: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/alertconfiguration/
- [statement] The last-daily-billed-amount condition uses USD and excludes credits applied for the previous day when calculating the billed amount. A threshold therefore need not match the net amount after credits. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions.md · keywords: Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API
- [statement] API keys and service accounts do not receive alert notifications by default. When project ownership is programmatic, configure an explicit destination such as email or a webhook so the alert reaches a recipient. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/configure-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] To manage project alerts, Atlas documents Project Owner or Project Alerts Manager access. Organization Owner users must add themselves to the project as Project Owner. Organization Billing Admin has limited authorization to manage billing alerts. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/configure-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Billing alerts are documented as notifications when a bill exceeds a USD limit. These sources do not establish that configuring an alert imposes a hard spending cap or automatically stops a cluster. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/ · keywords: Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas Admin API creates project alert configurations with POST /api/atlas/v2/groups/{groupId}/alertConfigs. The generated CLI equivalent is atlas api alertConfigurations createAlertConfig; groupId identifies the project. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/command/atlas-api-alertConfigurations-createAlertConfig.md · keywords: Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API · also: https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-sdk-go/blob/main/docs/doc_last_reference.md
- [statement] The Go SDK reference exposes project alert configuration listing (GET), updating (PUT), enabling or disabling (PATCH), and deletion (DELETE). It separately exposes GET /groups/{groupId}/alertConfigs/{alertConfigId}/alerts for open alerts triggered by a configuration. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-sdk-go/blob/main/docs/doc_last_reference.md · keywords: Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API
- [statement] Project billing event names include DAILY_BILL_OVER_THRESHOLD, DAILY_BILLING_CHANGE_OVER_THRESHOLD, WEEKLY_BILLING_CHANGE_OVER_THRESHOLD and MONTHLY_BILLING_CHANGE_OVER_THRESHOLD. The event catalogue marks these alertable; alert-condition documentation distinguishes daily dollar thresholds from percentage increases. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/atlas-alert-event-types.md · keywords: Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions.md
- [statement] Billing conditions have different scopes. Daily billed amount thresholds apply to both projects and organizations; the monthly organization-total and any-project monthly-total conditions are organization-only. A project alertConfigs endpoint must not be assumed to configure every organization billing condition. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions.md · keywords: Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API · also: https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-sdk-go/blob/main/docs/doc_last_reference.md
- [statement] Pulumi warns that some alert-variable validations were removed to unblock creation and directs users to the Atlas API documentation for current supported values. A provider accepting an input is insufficient evidence that a billing event and threshold combination is supported. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/alertconfiguration/ · keywords: Atlas billing alert configuration via Admin API
